description: A Personal Relationship Management tool to help you document your social life.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-11: a real install of Monica 4.1.2 — the current stable release; 5.x is still in beta — proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Its database is pinned from MariaDB 10.6.11 to 10.6.28: the older build segfaulted on this machine's WSL2 kernel moments after Monica finished setting up, which is why every earlier run answered HTTP 500.

risk_notes: Creates 2 Docker containers and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 2 credentials of its own, keeps them beside the app's data, and reuses them if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Monica asks you to create the first account when you open it; the account you create is the administrator.

image_pins.reason: The Runtipi definition runs MariaDB 10.6.11, from November 2022. On this machine's WSL2 kernel (6.6) that build segfaults moments after Monica finishes setting up — exit 139, 'Fatal signal 11' — reproduced by hand, and every request then fails with HTTP 500. 10.6.28 is the current patch of the same long-term line, so it carries no data migration.
